title: MIC selector signed vectors omit mandatory signer EUI-64
description: The mic_length_0_signed and mic_length_1_signed cases in test/vectors/mic_length_selector.json still set S without SI and omit signer_eui64 from the signed transcript/wire image. Update their generator and fixture to the mandatory S+SI encoding, add the canonical 8-byte signer EUI-64, recompute signature/wire values, and verify consumers.
